findings.description: Exact subject revision/Scheme/axis/value and assignment identity/revision maps, allowed-value and MethodRef semantics need owner review; no current generic Method Definition is invented.
Allowed record steps preserve selected stored fields. Immutable lifecycle/evidence snapshots versus external governance projections need explicit semantics; no live or unbounded preservation proof.
Fresh successor direction, same selected subject with potentially changed revision/value/version, permission and mistaken-target/retirement/history behavior need separate reviewed contracts.
Named basis/action/evidence-set and conditional method/implementation records do not establish execution, evidence sufficiency, confidence, counterevidence, owner decision or truth.

Candidate review lifecycle vocabulary and conditional Method/Implementation/evidence/history content differ from closed current carrier fields; historical missing-admission claims are stale and precedence is unresolved.
Selected no-other-axis inference policy and subject identity frame are not actual consumer compliance; authority/status/world truth remain separate.
Eighteen authored semantic uses, complete denominator, canonical reference resolution and common-carrier aligned closure remain unreviewed.
